text:
Tara (AE): Quick sync on Shoreline POC docs. Procurement sent back the MSA with a DPA clause demanding KMS attestation and insisted on Net60 for the PO. Their SecOps blocks DocuSign. Need path to sign + start Dedicated POC.

Ben (Legal): Paste the exact redline if you have it. Short answer: we can add a one-page KMS addendum committing to deliver an HSM attestation limited to their tenant keys within X business days. For signatures, we accept signed PDF uploads to our secure portal with audit log + mirrored email — that'll satisfy most infosec teams.

Tara (AE): Redline excerpt: "Vendor must provide KMS attestation and allow Customer access to key metadata prior to production onboarding." They also want SOC2 cert and a countersign method that doesn't call external signing APIs.

Ben (Legal): Proposed language: `Vendor will provide a signed KMS/HSM attestation limited to cryptographic material used by Customer within 7 business days of written request. On-prem or onsite key inspection requires a separate SOW.` I'll draft and attach. Portal-upload clause: `Signed PDF uploaded to Vendor secure portal with hash stored in audit log and mirrored email confirmation shall constitute a valid signature.`

Renee (Finance): Net60 is higher exposure. If PO < $20k we do Net30 automatically. For Net60 need CFO signoff and either: 1) $20k refundable hold, or 2) 50% upfront milestone. Also require PO number on invoice and wire details.

Ilya (Infra): Attestation ops note: we can generate an attestation signed by our HSM in ~3 business days if scope is limited to their tenant keys. On-prem verification or forensic key export isn't supported without a SOW. DocuSign blocked -> options: (a) they whitelist our signing IP 3.24.18.0/24 for a short window, (b) they upload signed PDFs to portal, or (c) we run a hosted signing page that submits via their browser (no outbound egress). (c) is often acceptable to SecOps.

docu-bot: Uploaded redline: https://secure.docs/redwood/shoreline/shoreline_msa_dpa_redline.pdf  Checklist created: [KMS addendum draft] [Finance Net terms decision] [Signature fallback confirmed] [SOC2 link sent]

Tara (AE): I'll ask procurement two quick Qs: 1) is Net60 mandatory or negotiable, 2) can they whitelist 3.24.18.0/24 for signing, or will they accept portal upload? PO estimate for POC ~14k.

Ben (Legal): Drafting addendum now; will limit attestation to tenant keys and commit to 7 business days. Will also include portal-upload signature text.

Renee (Finance): PO 14k -> Net30 fine. If they still press Net60, escalate to me and I'll request CFO approval + the refundable hold.

Ilya (Infra): If they pick option (c) (hosted signing via browser) we'll need a thumbs-up from SecOps that browser-based signing is allowed. Otherwise portal upload is the quickest. Provisioning timeline: once contracts signed and attestation requested, Dedicated POC staging ~10 business days.

Tara (AE): Great, I'll update after procurement responds. Thanks all :thumbsup:
